title: LLM semantic proposal to SAGE canonical record SOP
scope: all SAGE LLM and inference roles
principle: LLMs propose role-level semantic meaning; SAGE deterministically converts that meaning into canonical control records and alone owns authority, identity, invariants, provenance, validation, receipts, and continuation.
required_regressions: model output omits all SAGE internal control fields and still converts successfully
model-authored SAGE control fields are rejected at the semantic boundary
semantic intent maps deterministically to canonical SAGE boundary and invariant fields
clarification semantics fail closed when the required human question is absent
